name: What is the difference between an interior refresh and a whole-home remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between an interior refresh and a whole-home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: An interior refresh typically focuses on renovating specific areas like a kitchen or a primary bathroom, aiming for significant updates to those individual spaces. A whole-home remodel, by contrast, involves a coordinated transformation across multiple rooms, addressing inconsistent finishes, inefficient room flow, and outdated layouts throughout the entire residence. With AKN Design Group, both approaches benefit from our integrated design-build process, but a whole-home remodel ensures a cohesive aesthetic and functional flow across your entire living environment. The choice between them depends on whether your home requires targeted improvements or a comprehensive, unified update.
acceptedAnswer.description: An interior refresh targets specific areas like a kitchen, while a whole-home remodel involves a coordinated transformation across multiple rooms for a unified design.
